items.title: Google tells advertisers AI search queries now run 3x longer
items.rationale: Google's own advertiser briefing: AI search makes queries 3x longer and one in six multimodal, which changes how keyword and asset strategies should be built. The card should flag which figures lack a baseline.
items.excerpt: One in six searches is multimodal, Google's Shivani Mohan told advertisers. Google's May data limited that to US AI Mode. Which other figures lack a baseline?
